user.title: Install Cloud Photos
user.description:
Found the **Cloud Photos** add-on (`{addon_slug}`, state: `{addon_state}`).

Installing this integration will:

- Register the slideshow Lovelace card so any dashboard can use it
- Add a **Cloud Photos** badge to your default dashboard linking to the gallery
- Expose `cloud_photos.sync_now`, `cloud_photos.reset_slideshow`, and `cloud_photos.regenerate_thumbnails` services
- Add `sensor.cloud_photos_last_sync` and `sensor.cloud_photos_sync_status`

Continue?

abort.addon_not_installed: The Cloud Photos add-on is not installed. Install it from Supervisor → Add-on Store first, then come back here.

sync_now.name: Sync now
sync_now.description: Fetch new photos from the configured cloud provider using the cached session.

reset_slideshow.name: Reset slideshow
reset_slideshow.description: Wipe the local slideshow directory and re-download every photo from scratch.

regenerate_thumbnails.name: Regenerate thumbnails
regenerate_thumbnails.description: Rescan the photos dir, rebuild 600px thumbnails, and refresh _image_list.json.
